summary: DICK'S Sporting Goods filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, disclosing an underwriting agreement dated September 22, 2026, for a $1.0 billion registered senior notes offering: $400 million of 6.200% notes due 2036 and $600 million of 6.900% notes due 2056. BofA Securities, PNC Capital Markets and Wells Fargo Securities acted as representatives. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated, unguaranteed and structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities. Net proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, possibly including operations, debt repayment, share repurchases and future acquisitions. This routine investment-grade-style shelf takedown is not a special situation; watch leverage and buyback capacity.
